limits: Pure-model legal plans replay through real browser controls. Bag order, applicants and private Dutch reservations inform some plans; these prove reachable outcomes, not unaided play or fair human success probability.
Every desktop gameplay control uses native keyboard focus/Enter; every mobile gameplay action uses touchscreen taps. Mode selection is setup via the native select API before the game begins.
Chromium desktop and emulated touch at390/320px; not a physical-phone, other-engine or screen-reader study.
Late-stage optional-mode checks are pure-model generation constraints, not full browser completion at stage10003. Independent ordinary-input review is separate.

tide-and-retreat: Approach/withdraw alternatives sweep full lines; chains reject history and repeated direction
spore-council: Cloning conserves source; jumping empties it; touching enemies convert without ray bracketing
shared-comet: Slides stop at furthest ray endpoint, and blocked intermediate endpoints are not selectable
socket-skirmish: Captured installed hardware transfers to reserve; mover hardware remains attached
The next mover loses when neither installed movement nor reserve installation remains
cannon-council: Formation bombardment requires an empty muzzle and cannot fire through a nearer blocker
bloom-cauldron: Blue adjacency and ordered red/green bonuses use each ingredient’s actual preceding history
Automatic safe exhaustion pays the same completed-recipe bonus as choosing Bottle
three-fronts: Force is conserved and partial deployments cannot lock
package-yard: Clearing maximizes disjoint revenue and enforces exclusive personal bundles
falling-hammer: Waiting lets the rival preempt at its reservation; stopping spends exact current price
orderbook-wharf: Price/time priority and partial fills settle cash once; posted reserves block double spending
many-hands: Matching cap binds and failed-project refunds follow the shown rule
congestion-crossing: Shared-edge cost counts both fleets and public day changes
price-of-plenty: Endogenous price falls with output; investment adds capacity after the current sale
bargain-at-closing: Rejection changes outside options and reservation fractions while shrinking surplus
last-applicant: Later interviews permanently release earlier applicants and charge every interview
seasonal-ledger: Field-specific pest history, nitrogen conservation and adjacency all affect yield
permit-and-progress: Permits are consumed once and retrofits only affect later periods
school-of-shoals: Recruitment uses survivors after both catches; patrol tradeoff limits owned effort
